blocks.head: alt The user is near the device
alt The user holds stored message M
alt The user is away from deviceB
alt The user is near the device

state_rules.rule:
eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ...) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ...) > $ deviceB 'sendEncryptedText' UserX | (encrypt(randomStr('R', N), Key)) .

eq < UserX | ('message' : nils , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendEncryptedText' UserX | (Message) 
= < UserX | ('message' : Message , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : Owners , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceB ; encrypt(R, Key)) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'resetDevice' cloudA | (deviceB) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (nils , Owners) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('message' : encrypt(R, Key) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, R, Key) @ S < UserX | ('message' : encrypt(R, Key) , ..) > .

event_rules.rule:
